question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "send."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Send" **means to make something go or be taken somewhere, especially by mail, radio, etc. (कहीं कुछ भेजना या भिजवाना (विशेषतः डाक, रेडियो आदि के द्वारा))
 
• The reason for using** "send"** in the blank is to accurately describe the action of radio receivers and amplifiers on communication satellites.
 
• In this context, the term **"send"** implies the transmission or emission of radio waves from the satellite back to Earth.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is** Option 2.**
 
• **Correct paragraph:**

**​...........**These are helping aid in weather forecasting. Radio receivers and amplifiers on communication satellites can **send**__ waves back at a frequency that is different from the one the satellite received.........

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• Locate: **to find the exact position of somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के सही ठिकाने का पता लगाना)
 
• **Deliver: **to take something (goods, letters, etc.) to the place requested or to the address on it. (निर्दिष्ट या बताए गए ठिकाने या पते पर सामान, पत्र आदि पहुँचाना; वितरण करना)
 
• **Discharge: **to send something out (a liquid, gas, etc.). ((द्रव, गैस आदि को) छोड़ना)
